$comment: Haulcast UI strings (en-US). Stable dotted keys; {placeholders} are filled by the caller; _one/_other are plural forms (Intl.PluralRules). Voice rules: DESIGN.md section 13. No emoji, no arrows/inequality glyphs (Overpass lacks U+2192/2264/2265), no em or en dashes. Copied from .planning/design/microcopy.json with two changes: D-13 (banner.scenario.title is 'Simulated weather. Not a forecast.' instead of the dashed R14 spec string) and the added app.skipToMain (a design gap: the skip link needs a label on pages that have no trip planner).

app.name: Haulcast
app.title: Haulcast: weather-aware truck route planner
app.description: Compare three truck routes by forecast weather risk at the truck's own arrival time, with a 48-hour corridor forecast.

routing_unavailable.title: Routing is unavailable
routing_unavailable.body: The routing service isn't responding. Your trip is still in the form. Try again in a moment.

weather_unavailable.title: Weather data is unavailable
weather_unavailable.body: The forecast service isn't responding. Try again in a moment.

weather_capacity_exhausted.title: Forecast limit reached

rate_limited.title: Too many plans in a row

no_route_found.title: No truck route found
no_route_found.body: The router found no route between these places. Check both places and try again.

same_origin_destination.title: Same place twice
same_origin_destination.body: Origin and destination are the same place. Choose a different destination.

route_too_long.title: Trip too long
route_too_long.body: Routes over 3,000 miles aren't supported. Split the trip into shorter legs.

too_many_checkpoints.title: Too many checkpoints
too_many_checkpoints.body: This trip needs too many weather checks at a {interval}-mile interval. Choose 25 or 50 miles.

departure_out_of_range.title: Departure out of range
departure_out_of_range.body: Choose a departure from now up to 5 days ahead.

plan_not_found.title: This plan has expired
plan_not_found.body: Shared plans are kept for 7 days. Plan the trip again to get a new link.

heatmap_failed.title: Forecast map unavailable
heatmap_failed.body: Routes and checkpoints are ready, but the forecast map didn't load.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Check your connection, then try again.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: That's on our side. Try again. If it keeps happening, share the reference below.

methodology.title: How Haulcast scores weather risk
methodology.lead: Every checkpoint is scored with the weather forecast for the hour the truck is expected to be there, using the assessment's risk and load rules.
methodology.rankingNoTravel: No Travel miles are compared first, because No Travel is strictly worse than Severe. Then Severe miles, High miles, average risk and travel time.

footer.disclaimer: Haulcast is a planning aid, not a dispatch or safety certification. Check official conditions before you drive.
